name: Custom business systems built with AI: web, mobile app and AWS
description:
I design and build complete business systems with AI, then put them into production on AWS.

What you get:
- A discovery session to map your process and the data you already have
- A web admin system for your team, plus a mobile app if your staff work in the field
- An API and a database that you own, deployed on AWS with backups and monitoring
- Training and a handover document for your team

Systems I have built: dock and yard management with a driver app, field service and repair management, CRM, expense claims with approvals, AI reading of tax invoices, executive BI dashboards, event registration with QR tickets, and an online learning platform.

Background: 20+ years in enterprise IT, most recently Group IT Manager at BMW Leasing Thailand and BMW Insurance Broker.

The price depends on scope. Send me your process and I will reply with a plan and a quote.

name: AI Transformation program: bring AI into your whole company in 90 days
description:
A 90-day program that takes your company from "we should use AI" to real results, with a clear owner for every week.

How it runs (13 weeks, 6 phases, with a management review at the end of each month):
1. Prepare (weeks 1-2): set up the working team and announce an AI policy
2. Survey (weeks 3-5): interviews and a survey with the heads of each business function
3. Set goals (weeks 6-7): a company-wide picture, 3 to 5 goals per function, and baseline numbers
4. Select (week 8): approve the first 2 to 3 quick wins and open the AI Champion Challenge
5. Build (weeks 9-12): deliver the quick wins on systems you already own, and draft the scope for bigger projects
6. Measure (week 13): compare against the baseline, share lessons and plan the next round

What you get:
- A map of your core processes across 5 functions (marketing, operations, technology, admin and finance)
- Quick wins running on tools you already pay for, with no new system to buy
- An AI use policy your staff can follow
- A 6-week AI Champion Challenge where staff teams build and present real results on Demo Day

The price depends on company size and scope. Tell me about your company and I will reply with a proposal.

name: Make your own song with AI (ChatGPT + Suno) and release it on Spotify
description:
Learn to write, produce and release your own song with AI, in 3 one-hour sessions.

We go through the full workflow I use for my own releases:
- Lyrics and song direction with ChatGPT
- Generating the music with Suno and picking the best take
- Cover art, then release through a distributor such as DistroKid to Spotify and other streaming platforms

By the end you have a real song of your own and you know how to make the next one without help.

About me: I have released 10 AI-made songs on Spotify as Kosin Finsure.

Choose Basic, Advance or Professional below, and message me if you are not sure which one fits.

name: Private AI that runs offline on your own laptop or server
description:
For teams whose data cannot go to the cloud: I set up AI that runs entirely on your own machine, with no internet connection needed.

What I can set up, depending on your needs:
- A chat assistant that answers from your own documents and shows where each answer came from
- A voice assistant that understands and speaks Thai
- Image generation from a Thai description
- Business systems such as ERP running locally, connected to the AI

Example: for the ASUS ExpertBook showcase I ran five of these systems on a single laptop at once. Measured with every service running: 43 tokens per second, 1.7 s to the first spoken word, 8.6 s per image.

I check the license of every model I use, so you only get models that are allowed for commercial use.

The price depends on your hardware and use case. Tell me what you want the AI to do and I will reply with a plan and a quote.
